title: Gajaana
desc: On an adventurous search for treasure in the dense forest, a group of young explorers soon discovers they have become the quarry.

title: Kochi Rajavu
desc: Tragedy strikes when Unni accidentally kills his lover's cousin, resulting in his imprisonment.

title: Ee Parakkum Thalika
desc: Unni, a bus owner, tries several ways to improve the condition of his bus, which is named after his late father. Things take a turn when the daughter of a powerful politician enters his life.

title: Thuruppugulan
desc: Menon buys land for his five-star hotel and asks his trusted employee, Sreedharan Unnithan, to take its charge. Years later, Unnithan gets Menon imprisoned in a fake case and Kunjumon helps him.

title: Saamy 2
desc: Ramaswamy, who works as a front-end receptionist for Union Minister Viswanathan, decides to pursue civil service. Soon, Viswanathan's daughter falls in love with him after he saves her from gangsters.
